rejected_attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Godot 2.5D game object animation sheet
Input image: Image 1 is the sole identity, design, palette, material, outline, proportions, scale, and frontal viewpoint authority for the Library pearl lamp: one compact pale lavender open scallop shell on a layered shell base with a central round ivory pearl bulb.
Primary request: Create one 4 columns by 2 rows animation sheet containing exactly eight sequential full-object states of this exact lamp being switched on by an attached control. State 1 matches the reference, with the shell open and pearl bulb dim ivory. Add only one tiny functional gold pull-chain permanently attached to the right inner hinge of the shell, ending in a miniature pearl bead. In state 2 the real linked chain is pulled downward and taut. In states 3-5 the shell's actual upper fluted shade opens a few degrees wider at its real bottom hinge while the physical pearl bulb changes internally from dim ivory to warm golden light. States 6-7 show the attached chain rebounding upward in a small damped curve while the shade stays open and bulb stays lit. State 8 is the fully lit lamp settled, shade open, chain hanging vertically from its attachment.
Frame order: left-to-right top row, then left-to-right bottom row.
Style/medium: preserve the exact polished pastel storybook cel-shaded illustration, navy-purple outline, lavender shell facets, blush shadows, ivory pearl, painted highlights, compact silhouette, and child-readable geometry from Image 1; the small gold chain must match the existing trim style.
Composition: eight equal conceptual cells on a square sheet; identical complete lamp scale, center, real shell-hinge pivot, and bottom anchor in every cell; generous padding for the attached chain; no cropping.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat uniform solid #FF00FF chroma-key field throughout and between cells.
Constraints: redraw the complete coherent lamp in every state. The actual linked pull-chain, hinged shell shade, and contained pearl bulb change; do not bob, rotate, squash, or translate the whole lamp, and do not add a detached glow disc, background halo, rays, sparkles, bubbles, motion lines, or effect sprites. Illumination stays entirely inside the pearl and its painted highlight with no light cast on the chroma field. The chain must remain visibly attached in every state. No cell borders, grid lines, labels, numbers, text, floor, cast/contact shadow, reflection, scenery, or watermark. Background has zero texture, gradient, lighting variation, or shadow. Do not use #FF00FF in the lamp. Exactly eight states and no extra objects.
rejected_attempts.rejection_reason: Detached dark grounding/contact-shadow stroke remained below the shell base and the shade motion was too subtle; chain/light changes did not meet the actual-object-motion bar.
